line:

تتخلى عن ذاكرة ROM
ولم تعلّق نينتندو بعد
label: عاجل
note: reel_check (newsroom/reel-check.md not released; same items here). Story type: BUSINESS / SUPPLY. Ordered by Mohammad 4 Nov 14:43 Dubai: verify and post as breaking. VERIFIED: Taipei Times 29 Oct (Macronix chairman Miin Wu on the Q3 call: 'gradually phasing out of ROM production'; ROMs are used in Switch consoles); Macronix Q3 ROM share reported 5% of sales vs 26% a year ago (secondary); 'no new ROM products, Q3 last quarter reported separately' from David Gibson's X post 4 Nov 06:24Z and IG News, one step removed from Macronix's own slides (not read). Nintendo: no statement found. Nuance: ROHM is reported as the leading Switch 2 ROM maker, so cartridges are not ending. First report 29 Oct, the Switch angle spread on 4 Nov. Hook: the maker of Switch cartridge memory is leaving. Why now: it spread on 4 Nov (442K views on the X post). Players here: physical Switch and Switch 2 buyers in the Gulf; no supply change announced. Payoff: Nintendo has not commented. Footage route: none reachable for hardware or cartridges (Nintendo store trailers are narrated or captioned); one official image: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 key art from Nintendo's store page (the biggest physical Switch 2 release, 5 Nov), credited on screen. Sound: breaking bed. Names: Macronix bracketed at first mention. Sensitive: none.
